description: Removes from union `T` every member assignable to `U`.
Keeps from union `T` only the members assignable to `U`; great for picking discriminated union variants.
Removes `null` and `undefined`. Defined as `T & {}` since TypeScript 4.8.
Since TypeScript 5.5, simple callbacks like `x => x != null` are inferred as type predicates, so `filter` narrows.
